construction.operator: for each ordered pair A(base),B(veto), evaluate each base event t,s; use latest B event satisfying t-6h < v.entry <= t; no veto or same-side latest veto keeps base side; opposite latest veto suppresses to cash and never reverses
construction.reservation: candidate-local chronological half-open 8h reservation after active-veto materialization
construction.base_controls: normalized no-veto 8h half-open reserved controls built for each base component
construction.duplicate_policy: nonempty exact full schedule duplicates are rejected vs normalized bases, vs other current candidates with all duplicate group members rejected, and vs prior same-side/handoff/three-way schedules; empty schedules fail only source gates
